blogs.title: Beyond LoRA: Why 'Orthogonal' is the Next Frontier in Efficient AI Tuning
blogs.description: While LoRA has become the go-to method for adapting large models, this post explores a new paradigm: Orthogonal Finetuning (OFT). We'll explain how rotating weight matrices instead of adding new ones helps preserve the 'knowledge' of foundation models while maintaining incredible training stability.

blogs.title: The Butterfly Effect: How Fast Fourier Transforms are Helping Shrink AI Models
blogs.description: Inspired by the math behind the Fast Fourier Transform (FFT), researchers have found a way to compress massive matrices using 'butterfly structures.' This post breaks down how this clever mathematical trick allows us to achieve high-performance model adaptation with a fraction of the usual memory cost.

blogs.title: Mapping the Flow: Visualizing Neural Networks as Information Grids
blogs.description: What if we thought of matrix multiplication as a game of 'telephone' across a grid? This post dives into the paper's unique 'Information Transmission' framework, showing how viewing weight updates as paths for data flow helps us design more efficient and expressive AI architectures.

blogs.title: One Tool, Many Worlds: Adapting LLMs, Vision, and Diffusion Models with BOFT
blogs.description: Is there a 'universal' way to tune AI? We take a look at the empirical results of Orthogonal Butterfly (BOFT), demonstrating how this single method outperforms state-of-the-art techniques across three completely different fields: Large Language Models, Computer Vision, and Text-to-Image generation.
